title: Copilot PR CI auto-retry: selection and retry-budget rules live in retry.yml and retry.sh
answers: Why does a Copilot PR with auto-merge get its failed CI jobs rerun automatically?
Which PRs does the scheduled CI retry skip, and why is a commit skipped as retry-exhausted?
Where is the weekday JST schedule or dry_run default for the CI retry handled?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/retry.yml:rerun job runs on a 30-minute weekday JST schedule and on manual dispatch (dry_run defaults to true). It selects open, non-draft PRs authored by copilot-swe-agent, created within 72 hours, with auto-merge enabled and mergeable != CONFLICTING, and passes each PR's headRefOid to .github/workflows/retry.sh.
Rule: retry.sh:suites collapses a commit's check suites to the latest github-actions run per workflow path and event (group_by + max_by on createdAt, databaseId), excludes event 'dynamic', skips the commit while any run is not COMPLETED, and skips it when any failed run has runAttempt-1 >= MAX_RETRIES (3) or has no attempt count.
Rule: retry.sh:runs marks retry.yml and rerun-workflow-run.yml as non-rerunnable but still counts them in the budget; only protect.yml is flagged for the Protect ordering path.
Constraints: this changes only which failed jobs get rerun; merge requirements and branch protection are unchanged. Manual runs without dry_run=false only print eligible reruns.
applies: Anyone changing which PRs or which failed runs the Copilot CI auto-retry touches; not for retries of human or other-bot PRs (the workflow has a TODO for those).
says: Why did failed build checks on an auto-merge pull request rerun automatically?
Automated test retries stopped running after three failed build attempts on the pull request.
Failed checks on the bot pull request were not retried because auto-merge is disabled.
The automated retry job is skipping pull requests older than seventy-two hours.
Why are pull requests with merge conflicts excluded from scheduled test reruns?
search: Copilot PR CI auto-retry selection and budget rules are configured in .github/workflows/retry.yml and .github/workflows/retry.sh. The retry.yml rerun job runs on a 30-minute weekday JST schedule and manual dispatch (defaulting to dry_run=true), selecting non-draft PRs by copilot-swe-agent under 72 hours old with auto-merge enabled and no conflicts. In retry.sh, runs are grouped to the latest per path and event, dynamic events are excluded, incomplete runs block the commit, and runs exceeding MAX_RETRIES (3) are skipped. The retry.yml and rerun-workflow-run.yml workflows are non-rerunnable, while branch protection and merge requirements remain unchanged.
